intro: ForThePeople.in is India's citizen transparency platform, launched in 2026. We aggregate district-level government data — budgets, crop prices, water levels, scheme coverage, infrastructure, and more — and present it in a clear, accessible interface for every Indian. The platform covers {coverage} and plans to expand to all {total}+ Indian districts.
mission: To make government data as easy to access as checking the weather — so that every citizen, journalist, researcher, and elected representative can engage with governance based on facts.
builderBio: Entrepreneur and civic-tech advocate based in India. Built ForThePeople.in in 2026 as an independent public-interest project to help citizens, journalists, researchers, and elected representatives access India's government data in one place. Not affiliated with any government body or political organisation.
glanceSimple: Today ForThePeople.in is live in {d, plural, one {# district} other {# districts}} across {s, plural, one {# state} other {# states}}. India has {total}+ districts, and the plan is to cover every one of them.

pillar_data_desc: Every number comes from a government portal, official API or publicly available document. We never fabricate or estimate data.
pillar_reach_desc: Currently live in {coverage} — expanding to all {total}+ districts across India.
pillar_lang_desc: Data is shown in English and the language of each state: Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi and more.
pillar_time_desc: Crop prices and news are refreshed whenever the source portal publishes; every reading shows the date it was recorded. Budget and census data go back years. Both matter.
pillar_free_desc: No paywalls, no subscriptions. Government data belongs to citizens. We just make it accessible.
pillar_rti_desc: Don't see what you need? We provide ready-to-send RTI templates so you can get any government information by right.
sourcesBody: ForThePeople.in is an independent citizen transparency platform built on India's Right to Information principles (Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution). Data is aggregated from official Government of India portals released under the National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) 2012, accredited research institutions (IIPS for NFHS, ICMR, IMD), and publicly accessible verified sources (weather APIs, news headlines under fair use). We do not claim affiliation with any government body. Every numeric value is traceable to its original public source — please verify critical information at the source portal before acting on it.
src_agmarknet: Agricultural Marketing Information Network: crop mandi prices
src_wris: Water Resources Information System: dam and reservoir levels
src_imd: India Meteorological Department: rainfall and weather data
src_eci: Assembly and Lok Sabha election results and voter data
src_egram: Panchayat and finance data (MGNREGA, district budgets)
src_udise: School enrolment, pass rates, student-teacher ratios
src_pmay: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana housing scheme data
pledge1: Every data point is sourced from official government portals, public APIs and gazetted documents. We document every source on the <link>Data sources</link> page of each district.
pledge2: If you find an error, please <link>let us know</link>. We will correct it within 24 hours and publish the correction.
disclaimerBody: ForThePeople.in is an independent, non-governmental initiative. It is NOT an official government website. Data is sourced from public government portals under NDSAP and is provided for informational purposes only. For official records, always refer to the original government source.
